name: careerflow
description: CareerFlow - Production-grade Job Search & Career Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
